current.text: Collin Sexton is a bench guard. Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves start ahead of him. The projected starters are Doncic, Reaves, Grimes, Thybulle and Kessler.

The experts say not to draft him. Josh does not expect him to start or to be even a back-end fantasy option. Another expert calls him a stash in deep formats only and says to avoid him at an ESPN rank of 100.
He would only be useful with about 26% usage and 30 minutes a game. That would take injuries in the backcourt, with Doncic or Reaves missing a lot of games.
His Yahoo injury status is questionable (lower leg).
The Lakers have the second most back-to-backs in the league. With a March 28 end, their playoff schedule is 3-4-3 games, which is in the bottom half of the league.

durable.text: He is a notoriously bad fantasy player in category leagues.
He is a poor passer and has always been a weak assist player.
He is usually efficient and a good three-point shooter.
He is an undersized guard and a bad defender.

note: Sexton ranks 205 on Yahoo and 150 on ESPN, and both sites give him 0 value. He is outside the 144 players our auction drafts, so do not spend on him. Early in the season, check his lower leg (Yahoo Q) and whether Doncic or Reaves miss games, since that is the only way he gets the 30 minutes and high usage he needs. He brings some points and FT% but hurts REB, BLK and TO, and he played only 23.7 minutes last season, so he is a waiver pickup at most.
